body:
This doesn't account for e.g. CanvasLayer transform. I think using `xform`'s x axis angle/rotation should do the thing.
```suggestion
	double rotation = xform.get_rotation();
```

But apparently dragging the handles is totally broken when within a rotated CanvasLayer:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/071d106f-a37e-410c-afe0-541a2d7080ec

Changing:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/78c6632eb174aabb2790975cf83e28fee065b43d/editor/scene/2d/physics/collision_shape_2d_editor_plugin.cpp#L430

to:
```cpp
cpoint = (node->get_viewport()->get_popup_base_transform() * node->get_canvas_transform()).affine_inverse().xform(cpoint);
```
should fix this.

---

Also while at it, `original_transform.affine_inverse().xform(original_transform.get_origin())` is just a zero vector (it calculates object-local origin which is always zero). This only adds potential floating point error, can be removed:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/78c6632eb174aabb2790975cf83e28fee065b43d/editor/scene/2d/physics/collision_shape_2d_editor_plugin.cpp#L216
